rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Five factors with one line each: concentration (more collisions), temperature (2× rate per 10 °C rule of thumb), catalyst (lowers Ea), surface area (more contact), nature of reactants.  ·  Trick 2: Collision-theory framing: rate ∝ frequency of collisions × fraction with E ≥ Ea × proper orientation — map each factor onto one of the three.
